what it says: *** Valparaiso, Chile. Death Records September-December 1894 ***, DGS film 004702100, image 19, ark 3:1:939K-P9FG-8. Entry *** 54, page 28 ***, 'Rejistro de DEFUNCIONES en la Circunscripcion de *** EL ALMENDRAL ***, departamento de Valparaiso'. *** A PRINTED FORM, PLATE READ 9 October 2026 ***: nombre *** Lerena Diaz Juan Fernando ***, sexo masculino, nacionalidad *** CHILENA ***, edad *** diez meses ***, estado parvulo, domicilio *** Victoria, ochenta y uno ***; '*** Nombre de sus padres: padre ARTURO LERENA GARCIA, madre AMALIA DIAZ ***'. Died *** 18 September 1894 at one in the afternoon ***, of *** pulmonia ***; buried *** Playa Ancha ***.
what it settles: *** THE FATHER'S COMPOUND SURNAME NAMES HIS MOTHER: GARCIA. *** That is the first thing this archive has ever had about Arturo Lerena's parents, and it is a searchable handle. *** AND IT CONFIRMS THE WITHDRAWAL OF 13 SEPTEMBER: *** a man written LERENA GARCIA is not a son of *** AMBROSIA TRAIBEL ***. The conflation was correctly undone, and now it is undone on evidence.

what was read: *** AND A COUNTRY THIS ARCHIVE HAD NEVER OPENED ***
what it says: The family is at *** 81 Victoria, El Almendral, VALPARAISO, CHILE *** in September 1894, and the dead child is *** CHILENA *** by nationality
what it settles: *** CHILE HAS APPEARED IN THIS ARCHIVE ONLY AS A SURNAME-DISTRIBUTION FIGURE AND A DNA PROBE. *** It has never been a place where a record was read. *** IT IS NOW, AND IT WAS REACHED WITHOUT LOOKING FOR IT *** - by a parent-pair query that was aimed at Argentina.

what was read: *** AND IT MOVES THE FAMILY ACROSS THE ANDES AND BACK ***
what it says: The drawer gave three sons: *** Alejandro Guillermo, La Pampa 1889; Diaz Arturo, Mendoza 1896; Vicente, Entre Rios 1897. *** This act adds *** JUAN FERNANDO, born in Chile about November 1893 *** - ten months old on 18 September 1894.
what it settles: *** LA PAMPA 1889, VALPARAISO 1893-94, MENDOZA 1896, ENTRE RIOS 1897. *** *** MENDOZA IS THE ARGENTINE CITY AT THE FOOT OF THE PASS TO VALPARAISO ***, so the route is the ordinary one and the dates sit in order. *** AND THE INDEX'S BIRTH YEAR IS A YEAR OUT: *** it estimates 1894 from the death year; the act says ten months, which is about November 1893.

what was read: *** AND MORE CHILDREN THAN THE DRAWER SHOWED ***
what it says: The same parent-pair query returns, across Chile and Entre Rios: *** MERCEDES LERENA DIAZ, JORJE VICENTE LERENA, ANTONIO LERENA DIAZ, SOLEDAD ESTRELLA LERENA DIAZ, ARTURO LERENA DIAZ *** and a *** FERNANDO JUAN LERENA DIAZ *** beside the Juan Fernando read here
what it settles: *** THE ARMY DRAWER SHOWS ONLY SONS OF ENROLMENT AGE. THE CIVIL REGISTERS SHOW THE FAMILY. *** *** INDEX ONLY - NONE OF THESE ACTS IS OPENED HERE ***, and 'Fernando Juan' beside 'Juan Fernando' may be one child indexed twice or two children, which is exactly the kind of thing this archive will not decide from an index.

what it says: The Chilean form gives *** nacionalidad for the DECEASED only ***. It does not ask where the father was born.
what it settles: *** SO ARTURO LERENA GARCIA IS NOT YET PLACED IN A COUNTRY ***, where Carlos Lerena was placed in a city the same afternoon. *** WHAT WOULD PLACE HIM: *** his own marriage to Amalia Diaz, which would name his parents and his origin; or any of the Entre Rios civil registrations of his other children, which in that province routinely give the parents' nationality. *** HE IS RECORDED AS A LERENA GARCIA AND NOTHING MORE. ***

what was read: *** AND THE ENTRE RIOS MARRIAGE NAMES HIS NATIONALITY ***
what it says: *** Libro de matrimonios: Crespo, Entre Rios. Marriage Records 1924 ***, acta *** No. 144 ***, image ark 3:1:3QHV-V36C-H9QM-J. *** Crespo, departamento de Parana, 24 October 1924 ***, before Emilio F. Castellot, Director Jefe del Registro Civil. *** A PRINTED FORM WITH A 'de nacionalidad' BLANK FOR EACH PARENT, PLATE READ 10 October 2026: *** 'comparecieron *** ANTONIO LERENA DIAZ *** de veinte y ocho anos, de nacionalidad *** ARGENTINA ***, nacido en *** BUENOS AIRES ***, domiciliado en *** VILLA CRESPO ***, de profesion *** Empleado ***, hijo de *** ARTURO LERENA, de nacionalidad ESPANOLA, de profesion PERIODISTA ***, y de *** AMALIA DIAZ, de nacionalidad PERUANA ***, de profesion quehaceres domesticos'.
what it settles: *** ARTURO LERENA IS SPANISH, AND HE IS A JOURNALIST. *** From 'Not established' on 13 September to a nationality, a trade and a household in one act. *** AND AMALIA DIAZ IS PERUVIAN *** - which explains an index entry this archive could not parse: FamilySearch renders her on one card as *** 'Amalia Dias Peruane' ***, reading her nationality as part of her name.

what was read: *** AND HE SIGNS AS A WITNESS AT HIS SON'S WEDDING ***
what it says: 'Los testigos *** ARTURO LERENA ***, de *** cincuenta y [the units digit not confidently read] *** anos, de profesion *** PERIODISTA ***, de estado *** casado ***, domiciliado en *** PARANA ***' - and beside him Alejandro Mechot, sixty-two, rentista
what it settles: *** FIFTY-SOMETHING IN OCTOBER 1924, SO BORN ABOUT 1865-1874. *** *** THE AGE IS WHAT PROVES THE WITNESS IS THE FATHER AND NOT THE SON: *** an Arturo Lerena Diaz born 1896 would be twenty-eight. *** HE IS LIVING AT PARANA *** while his son lives at Villa Crespo in Buenos Aires. *** THE UNITS DIGIT IS NOT READ AND IS NOT GUESSED ***; the decade is what matters here and the decade is secure.

what was read: *** AND IT BREAKS A PATTERN THIS ARCHIVE PUBLISHED YESTERDAY ***
what it says: data/cajon-985-origins.tsv has said since 13 September that of the Lerena fathers in this drawer whose origin can be traced, *** 'EVERY ONE is Uruguayan or married in Uruguay' *** - and on 9 October Carlos Lerena was added to them as a Montevidean.
what it settles: *** ARTURO IS SPANISH AND HIS WIFE IS PERUVIAN, SO THE GENERALISATION IS BROKEN. *** Five fathers are now traceable: Gilberto (Montevideo 1855), Alejandro Maximo (Uruguay 1844), Nemesio Ramon (married Salto 1903), Carlos (natural de Montevideo) and *** ARTURO (ESPANOL) ***. *** WHAT SURVIVES IS THE WEAKER CLAIM: not one of them is Argentine. *** *** AND IT MATTERS FOR THE CENTRAL QUESTION: *** the base rate this archive was leaning on - that an Argentine Lerena of this generation is usually a Uruguayan family's son - is *** WEAKER THAN IT LOOKED YESTERDAY ***, and any inference about Juan Carlos Lerena drawn from it must be weakened to match. See data/corrections.tsv.

what was read: *** AND THE ITINERARY NOW MAKES SENSE ***
what it says: La Pampa 1889, *** VALPARAISO 1893-94 ***, Mendoza 1896, *** BUENOS AIRES about 1896 ***, Entre Rios 1897, Parana by 1924
what it settles: *** A SPANISH JOURNALIST MARRIED TO A PERUVIAN MOVES WHERE THE PAPERS ARE. *** The Chilean years stop being a puzzle: *** A PERUVIAN WIFE PUTS THE PACIFIC COAST INSIDE THE FAMILY'S ORBIT ***, and Valparaiso was the largest press city on it. *** THE BUENOS AIRES BIRTH IS NEW *** - the army drawer gave La Pampa, Mendoza and Entre Rios, and this act adds the capital.

what was read: *** AND THE BRIDE'S FAMILY, RECORDED BECAUSE THE ACT RECORDS THEM ***
what it says: *** CLARA HENRIETTE KNOF ***, *** fifteen ***, argentina, *** nacida en Crespo ***, domiciliada en Villa Crespo, quehaceres domesticos, *** hija de OTTO KNOF (fallecido) *** y de *** IDA PONTOPHIDAN ***
what it settles: *** A GERMAN-DESCENDED FAMILY OF THE ENTRE RIOS COLONIES ***, which is what Crespo was. *** SHE IS FIFTEEN AND HE IS TWENTY-EIGHT ***, and the act records that the bride's mother gave her consent in person. *** HER PARENTS ARE ENTERED BECAUSE THE ACT NAMES THEM ***, not because anything yet connects them to this archive's question.
